Partitions

Storage governed by the OpenWindows Storage specification.

A SuperUnicode Partition is a removable filesystem whose layout is declared by SuperUnicode machine instructions. Two formats exist, from the OpenWindows Storage specification (libowfs.a and libusfs.a):

Format Description
OWFS Native drive filesystem. Data starts at drive offset 0x10000; integrity is CRC32c + Fletcher-64; identity via htl_device_t/ow_sec; optional ChaCha20 data-at-rest encryption.
USFS Portable external-media filesystem for removable drives.

Policy

Partition type Allowed formats Used by Mounted
SuperUnicode Partition OWFS or USFS Base SUCS — bugfix and rescue payloads only read-only
SuperUnicode Plugin Partition OWFS exclusively ExtSUCS plugins (Extended-only) read-only, after the boot checksum gate

Plugin partitions are never USFS and never writable. Quarantined (gate-failed) plugins are never mounted and never register ranges. The full policy text is in both Public trees under partitions/spec.txt.
